name: Gnarlborn
summary: Tree-like folk of Ardengloom, rooted and hard to move, who bind foes with branches, sense the ground and borrow the Elderwoods' wisdom each dawn.

traits.name: Deep Roots
traits.summary: Advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being moved against your will, and on saves to avoid the Prone condition.
traits.text: You have Advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being moved against your will and on saving throws to avoid the Prone condition.

traits.name: Elderwood Whispers
traits.summary: At the end of a Long Rest, gain one skill proficiency, tool proficiency or language of your choice, lasting until your next Long Rest.
traits.text: You draw on the memory of the Elderwood spirits. When you finish a Long Rest you gain proficiency with one skill, one tool, or one language of your choice, lasting until you next finish a Long Rest. The pick can be changed at every Long Rest.

options.name: Skill
options.summary: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

options.name: Tool
options.summary: Proficiency with one tool of your choice.

options.name: Language
options.summary: You learn one language of your choice.

traits.name: Grasping Branches
traits.summary: Bonus Action: a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet makes a Strength save (DC 8 + Con + PB): Restrained for 1 minute on a failure (repeat save at each of its turn ends), half Speed until the end of its next turn on a success. Once per Short Rest.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action you unleash the binding power of the dark wood on a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet. It makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failure it has the Restrained condition for 1 minute as branches ensnare it; on a success its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. A Restrained creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The branches vanish when the condition ends. Once you use this trait you cannot use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Root Sense
traits.summary: Bonus Action: Tremorsense 60 feet for 10 minutes; once per Short Rest.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. Once you use this trait you cannot use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Towering Size
traits.summary: Advantage on ability checks to end the Grappled condition; you count as one size larger for carrying capacity.
traits.text: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
